<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_USICourseRegistration" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USICourseRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_USICourseRegistration">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_WantsToRegister</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SlotsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NoSlots</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCourse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountExists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckEligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestActivation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveActivationResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountPathsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogIn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TweetFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteCourseRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePaymentInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveCourseTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RegistrationComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SportsInstituteSystem" name="Sports institute system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCourseAvailability</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowCoursesAndDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_WantsToRegister" name="Want to register for a course"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCourseAvailability" name="Check course availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" name="Are slots free?" default="Flow_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoSlots" name="No free course slots"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" name="Show courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select a course"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check whether an account exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Already have an account?" default="Flow_NoExistingAccount"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity" name="Check eligible university registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" name="Registered at an eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse" name="Wait for activation response"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge" name="Account paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetChoice" name="Tweet to friends?" default="Flow_SkipTweet"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends who might want to join"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetMerge" name="Tweet paths merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteCourseRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket" name="Receive course ticket"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RegistrationComplete" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="StartEvent_WantsToRegister" targetRef="Task_CheckCourseAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_SlotsGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckCourseAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsAvailable" name="Slots are free" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSlots" name="No free slots" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowCourses_SelectCourse" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesAndDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCourse_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExistingAccount" name="Already have an account" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExistingAccount" name="No account" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckUniversity_EligibilityGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="Not registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterAccount_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestActivation_ReceiveResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveResponse_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_LogIn" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogIn_TweetChoice" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_TweetChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet" name="Tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipTweet" name="Do not tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetMerge_CompleteRegistration" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteCourseRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteRegistration_ProvidePayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteCourseRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvidePayment_ReceiveTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTicket_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCourseTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_RegistrationComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
